correctness.rationale: The ordinary five-crown matching complex is precisely 5×5 nonattacking rooks excluding the five diagonal cells. Direct face enumeration gives counts (1,20,130,320,265,44) including the empty face, independently repeated. Reviewed integer boundary matrices have ranks (19,111,208,44); mod101 supplies lower bounds, chain composition and 20-vertex connectivity bound ranks d1,d2 above, d4≤44, and explicit eight-triangle octahedral two-cycle z with integral cocycle phi satisfying δphi=0, <phi,z>=2 bounds rank d3≤208 over Q. Thus reduced Betti ranks are H2=1,H3=13. Signed Lefschetz traces of all 240 row/column-preserving and transpose automorphisms, independently re-enumerated, give the 14 S5×C2 class values. Inner products force the H2 line to be trivial S5 times transpose sign and H3 to be S(4,1)⊕S(3,2) even plus S(2,1,1,1) odd. The absence of trivial G constituents follows.
